⚔️ About the game

Brutal Ages is a war through the ages, from caves to space mechs. Build an army, defend your base with towers, gain experience, evolve into the next age and destroy the enemy base before they destroy yours. Play alone against the computer, in the campaign, in endless survival, or online with friends (1 vs 1, co-op against the computer, 2 vs 2).

▶ Play in the browser 📲 Download for Android 📜 Changelog

📖 How to play

  • Gold comes from killed enemies. Spend it on units (they go into a queue and train one by one), towers, tower slots and upgrades.
  • Experience (XP) comes from kills. When you have enough, the Evolve button takes you to the next age – new units, towers and a stronger base.
  • Towers stand on your base and shoot at enemies. Extra tower slots (max. 4) cost 1,000, 3,000, 7,500 gold; a tower can be sold for half its price.
  • Upgrades: ⚔️ Attack +12 % per level, ❤️ Health +15 % per level, 🏰 Walls +20 % per level. The level cap rises with the age.
  • The special attack (meteors, arrows, artillery…) has a 50 s cooldown. The hero is a strong unit with a Crushing blow.
  • Orders under the top bar: ⚔️ Attack, 🛡 Hold (soldiers stay by the towers), ↩️ Retreat.
  • At the start of a game and after every evolution you pick a nation for that age – each has a different bonus, look and special unit.
  • The ℹ button in battle shows cards of all your units with their numbers.

🗺 Campaign

The campaign leads through 25 territories across history in two chapters. The second chapter (Return of the horde) unlocks after conquering the last territory of the first one, and each of its missions is harder than the one before. Each mission gives 1–3 stars; conquered territories give permanent bonuses to your general. The Red Horde sometimes attacks a conquered territory – you have to defend it, otherwise its bonus stops working.

I. History of the world

  1. 🏞️ River valley – Easy
    Your tribe survived a long winter in the caves. In spring it descends into the River valley, where there's enough fish and game for everyone. But the Red Horde camps on the other bank – and it won't share. Drive them out!
  2. 🦣 Mammoth plains – Normal
    Beyond the river lie frozen plains full of mammoths. Whoever controls the herds, won't go hungry. The Red Horde has its winter camp here and more supplies than you.
  3. 🌋 Fire mountain – Hard · 👹 boss: Sabre-toothed tiger
    The Horde retreated to the volcano and summoned all clans. Their shaman claims, the mountain is on their side. Withstand their furious attack for 5 minutes, until they run out of strength.
  4. 🌾 Mill ford – Normal
    Centuries passed. Your tribe grew into a kingdom, and the Red Horde into the Red Duchy. Knights clash for the first time at the mill ford in the morning fog.
  5. 🏰 Castle on the rock – Normal
    The Duke barricaded himself in a castle on the rock. His walls are almost twice as strong as yours. It won't work without a proper siege.
  6. ⚔️ Bloody plain – Hard · 👹 boss: Dragon
    The Duke sent for reinforcements from the east. You must defeat him before, they arrive – you have 12 minutes.
  7. ⚓ Harbour – Normal
    The age of discovery. The duchy became the Red Empire with a fleet and muskets. Take the harbour, their ships sail from.
  8. 💣 Artillery hill – Hard
    The empire gathered cannons and powder kegs on the hill. They start with a full treasury – you only with what, you can carry.
  9. 🌙 Night raid – Hard · 👹 boss: Leonardo's armoured car
    Under cover of night you sneak to their camp. You can't build fortifications in the dark – only your army decides.
  10. 🏭 Factories – Normal
    Chimneys, railways, tanks. The empire became the Red Republic and its factories spew weapons day and night. Stop production.
  11. 🪖 Trenches – Hard
    The war is stuck in the trenches. The enemy is preparing a big offensive. Hold the line for 7 minutes at any cost.
  12. 🏛️ Capital – Hard · 👹 boss: Giant tank
    The republic's last bastion. Take their capital in winter and snow.
  13. 🛰️ Spaceport – Hard
    The future. The remains of the Red Republic fled into orbit and command robot armies from there. Take their ground spaceport.
  14. 🤖 Robot factory – Hard
    The republic's AI builds machines faster, than you can destroy them. Destroy the factory within 15 minutes, or it'll be too late.
  15. 👑 Last battle – Impossible · 👹 boss: Titan
    Everything is decided now. Horde, duchy, empire, republic and machines – their whole history against yours. Win and the world is yours.

II. Return of the horde

  1. ⏳ Rift in time – Impossible
    Did you think, it was over? The Red Horde's shaman opened a rift in time and his warriors are returning to the dawn of history – stronger and fiercer than ever. Close the rift, while it's still small!
  2. 🧊 Frozen lake – Impossible · 👹 boss: Sabre-toothed tiger
    The horde has pushed you onto a frozen lake. The ice is cracking, loot is scarce and a sabre-toothed tiger emerges from the blizzard. Survive 8 minutes, until reinforcements arrive.
  3. 🛡️ Templar fortress – Impossible
    The Red knights took a fortress with walls two and a half times stronger than yours and full cellars. The siege will be long and bloody.
  4. ☠️ Plague village – Impossible · 👹 boss: Dragon
    The plague rages across the land. There's nothing to take from fallen enemies, so you get less gold per kill – and a dragon is already circling over the valley. You must end it within 21 minutes.
  5. 🏴‍☠️ Pirate cove – Impossible · 👹 boss: Leonardo's armoured car
    The Red pirates hide the treasure of the whole empire in the cove. You can't build towers on the cliffs in a storm – only your army can do it.
  6. 🏚️ Besieged city – Insane · 👹 boss: Giant tank
    The city is surrounded, the winter is harsh and the enemy has supplies for a year. Hold it for 11 minutes, until help arrives.
  7. 🚂 Iron curtain – Impossible
    The horde has lowered an iron curtain – technology no longer advances here, not for you, nor for them. You must break through their fortifications within 23 minutes using only the technology you have now.
  8. 🌑 Moon base – Impossible · 👹 boss: Titan
    On the Moon the horde is building a new time machine. Loot is scarce, the walls are strong and a Titan guards them.
  9. ⚙️ Machine uprising – Insane · 👹 boss: Titan
    All the machines of the world have turned against you. The horde's insane AI attacks with all its might and loot is scarce. Survive 15 minutes.
  10. ♾️ End of time – Insane · 👹 boss: Titan
    The horde's shaman sits in the time machine at the very end of history. He has endless armies, a full treasury and walls like a mountain. This really is the final battle.

🔥 Heroic difficulty

Every conquered mission can be played again on heroic difficulty: the opponent is one level harder, has 35 % stronger walls and more gold, time limits are shorter and survival is longer. A win gives you a 👑 crown on the map.

♾ Endless survival

Enemies come in waves, each one stronger; every tenth wave brings a boss (from wave 25 every fifth). From wave 21 the enemies grow stronger faster with each wave – more health, stronger attacks and super soldiers. The enemy base cannot be destroyed – the goal is to survive as many waves as possible. Records go to the online leaderboard.

At the start of wave 11, 21, 31… you pick one of three random bonuses (they stack):

  • 💰 Loot – +25 % gold per kill
  • ⚔️ Sharp weapons – Units attack 15 % harder
  • 🛡️ Armour – Units have 15 % more health
  • ⏱️ Training – Unit production 15 % faster
  • 🏹 Fortification – Towers attack 30 % harder
  • ✨ Recharge – Army abilities recharge 25 % faster
  • 🧱 New walls – The base gets 30 % more health and is repaired
  • 🪙 Treasure – Get gold right away based on your age

📅 Daily challenge

Every day a different battlefield, opponent and rules – the same for everyone. Scored with stars and time.

🎯 Challenges

  • No walls – Normal opponent, but you can't build towers.
  • Pauper – You start without gold and get 30 % less per kill.
  • David and Goliath – The opponent starts in the Middle Ages with a double base.
  • Ranged only – Hard opponent. You may only build ranged units (2. jednotku).
  • Eternal Stone Age – Nobody can evolve. Hard opponent.
  • Blitz – Beat a hard opponent within 10 minutes.
  • Survive – Survive 10 minutes against Impossible difficulty.
  • Immortal – Beat Impossible difficulty without a single tower.

A completed challenge gives you a new army colour.

🌐 Playing with friends

  • 1 vs 1 duel, Co-op vs PC and 2 vs 2 – the host creates a game and shares a 5-letter code, the others enter it under Join. Works between the web and the app too.
  • Team play: every player has their own gold and nation (their units look like their nation). Whoever kills gets the full reward and the teammate gets a share on top (35 % / 25 % / 20 % / 15 % / 10 % by difficulty, 25 % in 2 vs 2). The build queue has 9 slots in a team. The base, towers, upgrades and evolution are shared.
  • Three players: in the 2 vs 2 lobby everyone picks a team and the smaller team can get the computer as a teammate.
  • Spectator mode (👁), emotes and quick messages during the game, rematch after the end, tournaments for a group of friends.
  • Online leaderboard (Elo rating from online duels) and a survival leaderboard.
  • Leagues by rating: 🪵 Wooden league (0+), 🥉 Bronze league (900+), 🥈 Silver league (1100+), 🥇 Gold league (1300+), 💎 Diamond league (1500+), 👑 Master league (1700+).
  • Clan war: clan members collect points every week (online duel win 10 / loss 2, 2v2 win 6, campaign 3, heroic mission 6, against the computer 1–4, survival 2 for every 10 waves, challenges 2). Clans are ranked by the weekly total.
  • 👁 Watch a friend: when a friend is playing online, a button appears next to them in your friends list – you join as a spectator without typing a code.
  • 🎬 Battle recording: after a game the whole battle is saved (Play solo → Last battle) and its highlights can be sent to a friend in messages.

🎖 Headquarters

👤 Profile

Every game gives you experience and you climb the ranks: Recruit → Private → Lance corporal → Corporal → Sergeant → Staff sergeant → Master sergeant → Warrant officer → Lieutenant → First lieutenant → Captain → Major → Lieutenant colonel → Colonel → General → Marshal → Warlord.

Emblems for your base flag: 🐺 Wolf (lvl 2) · 💀 Skull (lvl 3) · ⚔️ Swords (lvl 5) · 🦅 Eagle (lvl 7) · 👑 Crown (lvl 9) · 🐉 Dragon (lvl 12) · ⚡ Lightning (lvl 15) · 🔥 Flame (lvl 18) · ⭐ Star (lvl 22) – and one secret one. 🤫

🎖 General

Profile levels, campaign stars and completed quests give you general points. Spend them in the skill tree – the bonuses apply in battles against the computer.

⚔️ Army

  1. Units +5 % health and attack
  2. Units another +5 % health and attack
  3. Units 6 % cheaper
  4. Hero +10 % health and attack
  5. 📯 War cry: every 45 s your whole army hits 8 s 30 % harder

🏰 Defence

  1. Walls +8 %
  2. Towers 8 % cheaper
  3. Walls another +8 %
  4. Towers another 8 % cheaper
  5. 🛡 Last bastion: once per battle, a base under 20 % health heals back to half

💰 Economy

  1. +6 % gold per kill
  2. +25 % gold at the start of battle
  3. +6 % gold and XP per kill
  4. Unit production 8 % faster
  5. 💎 Spoils of war: heavy units and bosses give double gold

Heroes also collect gear (⚔️ Weapon from 2 wins, 🛡 Armour from 5 wins, ✨ Legendary piece from 10 wins).

✅ Quests and skins

Every day you get new quests and every week one big quest. They give general points and gradually unlock army skins.

  • Win 2 games (weekly: Win 10 games)
  • Kill 100 enemies (weekly: Kill 1500 enemies)
  • Build 4 towers (weekly: Build 40 towers)
  • Build 3 special units (weekly: Build 30 special units)
  • Reach in battle the Renaissance
  • Play 1 game with friends (weekly: Play 8 games with friends)
  • Get 2 stars in the campaign (weekly: Get 12 stars in the campaign)

Army skins

  • Default – army colour from profile
  • Golden guard – golden armour (for 3 completed quests)
  • Camo – military green (for 6 completed quests)
  • Skeletons – undead army (for 10 completed quests)
  • Neon – bright future (for 15 completed quests)
  • Bloody – for true brutes (for 20 completed quests)

🏳️ Nations and 📊 Statistics

You can preset a favourite nation for every age. Statistics show wins and losses by difficulty, online record, units killed and records; after every battle there is a chart of army strength.

👥 Friends, clans and messages

  • Every player has an ID (BA-XXXXXX) and a unique nickname. Find friends by name or ID, send a request and once accepted you can compare stats, send messages 💬 and invite each other to games.
  • Add recent opponents as friends with the ➕ Friend button in “Play with friends”.
  • A clan is a group with a shared tag on the leaderboard, a member overview and a weekly clan challenge. Invite friends and recent opponents with the 📨 Invite to clan button.

🏞 Battlefields, weather and events

  • Meadow – no restrictions
  • Desert – sandstorms sometimes shorten ranged range
  • Winter – everyone is 8 % slower
  • Swamp – everyone is 15 % slower
  • Forest – ranged units have 15 % less range
  • Volcano – lava sometimes bursts from the ground

Weather can be real, based on your location (Clear, Cloudy, Rain, Storm, Snow, Fog). Longer battles turn into night – soldiers light their way with torches, flashlights and lasers.

Battle events

  • Sandstorm – ranged units can't shoot far!
  • 🦖 T-REX IS BACK!
  • Earthquake!
  • Chest of gold!
  • Mercenaries joined the weaker side!
  • Solar eclipse
  • Meteor shower!

🩸 Brutal mode

For the hardened: blood, severed limbs, chopped-up animals and falling bosses. Turn it on in Settings → Game. And whoever looks closely will find a few secrets. 🥚

⚙ Settings and tips

  • Graphics Low to Ultra, 📉 Auto graphics (lowers quality when the phone struggles), 🔋 Battery saver (30 fps and a lower resolution), 📈 FPS counter.
  • ☁️ Progress backup: a code moves your whole progress to another phone or computer.
  • The game is in Czech and English, works offline and can be added to the home screen as an app.
  • The app updates itself – new versions are downloaded at startup. What's new: Settings → About → 📜 What's new.
